name: Weekly report
description: Reads repositories and logs since the last run, ranks findings by severity with evidence, and compares them with the previous report (new, unchanged, resolved). Files a task per high finding and messages the owner. Pull requests and deletions need an approval step that arrives in a later version; until then this only reports and files tasks.
